description: Transfer the LRA6 active site onto bll6422 and tabulate pocket residues by distance to the Mg2+ and pyruvate ligand
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
PR="/agent/jobs/be6dde12-f424-4543-aa88-9103cb899c33/provenance/"
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(path,chain=None):
    res={}
    for ln in open(path):
        if ln[:6].strip() not in ("ATOM","HETATM"): continue
        if chain and ln[21]!=chain: continue
        rn=ln[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3 or ln[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        res.setdefault(int(ln[22:26]),{"aa":AA3[rn],"at":{}})["at"][ln[12:16].strip()]=np.array(
            [float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
    return res
def fit(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T
    return R,qc-R@pc
ap=lambda R,t,X:(R@X.T).T+t
lra=parse(PR+"8GSR.pdb","A"); bll=parse(PR+"AF-Q89GC3.pdb")
seed=[(119,140),(121,142),(150,171)]
R,t=fit(np.array([lra[a]["at"][x] for a,b in seed for x in ("CA","CB")]),
        np.array([bll[b]["at"][x] for a,b in seed for x in ("CA","CB")]))
lk=sorted(lra);bk=sorted(bll)
LCA=np.array([lra[k]["at"]["CA"] for k in lk]);BCA=np.array([bll[k]["at"]["CA"] for k in bk])
for cut in [9,8,7,6,5,4.5,4,4,4]:
    X=ap(R,t,LCA);D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None,:]-BCA[None,:,:],axis=2)
    pr=[(i,int(D[i].argmin())) for i in range(len(lk)) if D[i].min()<cut and D[:,D[i].argmin()].argmin()==i]
    if len(pr)<10: break
    R,t=fit(LCA[[i for i,_ in pr]],BCA[[j for _,j in pr]])
rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(np.sum((ap(R,t,LCA[[i for i,_ in pr]])-BCA[[j for _,j in pr]])**2,1)))
l2b={lk[i]:bk[j] for i,j in pr}
mgp=None; pyr=[]
for ln in open(PR+"8GSR.pdb"):
    if not ln.startswith("HETATM") or ln[21]!="A": continue
    rn=ln[17:20].strip(); c=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
    if rn=="MG" and mgp is None: mgp=ap(R,t,c[None,:])[0]
    if rn=="PYR": pyr.append(ap(R,t,c[None,:])[0])
pyr=np.array(pyr)
# pocket = bll6422 residues with any atom within 8 A of the transferred Mg
d=[(min(np.linalg.norm(c-mgp) for c in bll[k]["at"].values()),k) for k in bk]
pocket=sorted([(dd,k) for dd,k in d if dd<8.0])
b2l={v:kk for kk,v in l2b.items()}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6,7.0))
ys=np.arange(len(pocket))[::-1]; labs=[];cols=[];vals=[]
for (dd,k) in pocket:
    lr=b2l.get(k); same = lr is not None and lra[lr]["aa"]==bll[k]["aa"]
    labs.append("%s%d"%(bll[k]["aa"],k)+(("  (LRA6 %s%d)"%(lra[lr]["aa"],lr)) if lr else "  (no equivalent)"))
    cols.append("#2e7d32" if same else ("#c62828" if lr else "#9e9e9e")); vals.append(dd)
ax.barh(ys,vals,color=cols,height=0.72)
ax.set_yticks(ys);ax.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("distance from nearest atom to the transferred Mg$^{2+}$ position (Å)")
ax.set_xlim(0,9)
for y,v,(dd,k) in zip(ys,vals,pocket):
    ax.text(v+0.12,y,"%.1f"%v,va="center",fontsize=7,color="#444")
ax.axvline(2.6,ls=":",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(2.65,ys[0]+0.2,"direct coordination",fontsize=7.5)
i93=[i for i,(dd,k) in enumerate(pocket) if k==93]
ax.set_title("bll6422 active site built from LRA6 (PDB 8GSR, EC 3.7.1.26) by superposition\n"
             "%d equivalent CA, %.2f Å RMSD; green = same residue as LRA6, red = substituted"%(len(pr),rms),fontsize=10)
ax.annotate("Arg93: LRA6 has Leu84 here,\nthe fumarylpyruvate hydrolase\nsubfamily has Arg",
            xy=(0.1,0.12),xycoords="axes fraction",fontsize=8.5,color="#c62828",
            bbox=dict(fc="#fff3f3",ec="#c62828",lw=0.8))
ax.grid(axis="x",alpha=0.3);ax.set_axisbelow(True)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
import pandas as pd
rows=[]
for dd,k in pocket:
    lr=b2l.get(k)
    rows.append(dict(bll6422="%s%d"%(bll[k]["aa"],k),LRA6_8GSR=("%s%d"%(lra[lr]["aa"],lr)) if lr else "",
                     identical=(lr is not None and lra[lr]["aa"]==bll[k]["aa"]),
                     dist_to_Mg_A=round(dd,2),
                     dist_to_pyruvate_A=round(float(min(np.linalg.norm(c-p) for c in bll[k]["at"].values() for p in pyr)),2) if len(pyr) else None))
pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(PR+"table_8GSR_active_site_transfer.csv",index=False)
print(pd.DataFrame(rows).to_string(index=False))
